description: Use when the user wants to browse or discover published competitive-intelligence reports (e.g. by topic, role, or industry) rather than fetch one specific report by slug. Filter by industry or target_role; results are ordered newest-first. This returns summaries only: to read or quote a report, call get_report with the item's slug — don't answer from the list. URLs follow https://industry-lens.com/reports/<slug>.
name: list_reports
title: List IndustryLens intelligence reports
